$description:
Trigger contract — controls whose main job is to open another surface.

Covers DropdownMenuTrigger, PopoverTrigger, SelectTrigger, NavigationMenu
trigger, Menubar trigger, and disclosure-style triggers. A trigger can render
as button-like, field-like, or navigation-like, but it needs an explicit open
state so "pressed" is not confused with Button's momentary press.

Axis-dependent hooks resolve at the recipe use-site:
  --a63-trigger-background       -> transparent / field background / action fill
  --a63-trigger-foreground       -> var(--a63-text-primary)
  --a63-trigger-hover-background -> var(--a63-surface-control-hover)
  --a63-trigger-open-background  -> var(--a63-surface-control-hover)

shadow.$description:
`0 0 #0000` not `none` — composed into comma-separated box-shadow lists
   alongside the focus ring, where `none` invalidates the declaration.
